title: Family Emergency Action Plan
description: Builds a written all-hazards plan around FEMA's family communication plan: an out-of-town contact, texting instead of calling, ICE contacts, wallet cards, and indoor, neighborhood, out-of-neighborhood, and out-of-town meeting places. Covers school and work plans, family roles, plans for fire, sheltering, evacuation, and separation, drills, and a fill-in template.
shortDescription: Out-of-town contact, text-first, four meeting places, roles, and a fill-in plan
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
